answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 33 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in vault, queued in grove, and inlet publishes the wait time. A farm of 134 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2182 identities would post 1217 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
